summary: SRv6 steers packets using a list of 128-bit segment identifiers in the IPv6 header. This RFC defines new flavors of the SRv6 endpoint behaviors from RFC 8986 that compress the segment list, greatly reducing the encapsulation size needed to express a path.

eli5.summary: A long list of directions takes lots of space on a packet. This writes the directions in a shorthand to make the packet lighter.
